source: Hal Leonard guitar recorded-versions book (notation + TAB), The Allman Brothers Band — the owner's iPhone-scanned PDF 'Allman bros Hal Leonard sheet music examples' (41 pages, book pp. 36-76), pages 3, 5 and 20, rendered with: pdftoppm -gray -f N -l N -scale-to-x 1500 -scale-to-y -1 -png <pdf> p (→ p-03.png, p-05.png, p-20.png). Pages NOT in the repo (copyright); chord symbols per system read by hand (2026-11-15).
note: systems: one list per system (rhythm-slash line and/or vocal staff + guitar notation + TAB, joined at the left edge), top to bottom; [bar within the system (1-based), chord]. ys: the system's TOP 5-line staff top-line y in the 1500-px render. p-03 systems 3-4 carry their chords above a one-line rhythm-slash staff, ~10 spaces over the vocal staff; p-20 '*Cm/Eb' has a footnote star.
